newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's king says Israeli policies destroy peace.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's king says Israeli policies destroy peace.

text.p: King Hussein of Jordan has warned Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in a letter that his policies were destroying the Middle East peace process, the official Petra news agency said on Tuesday.

"The path that you have pursued appears to lead to the destruction of everything I have believed in," the king, Netanyahu's closest Arab ally, told the Israeli prime minister in a letter published in Arabic by Petra.

"My pain is real and deep because of the accumulated acts of a tragic nature which you have started as the head of the government of Israel, making peace, which is the most important aim of my life, appears more and more like a distant mirage," Petra quoted the king as saying.
It said the king told Netanyahu he could not accept "excuses" that the Israeli prime minister was forced under duress into the decisions that have angered Palestinians and the Arab world.

"The bitter truth which I see, is that I do not find in you a person who stands by me to implement the will of God to achieve a final compromise between all the grandsons of Abraham," it reported King Hussein as telling Netanyahu.
Jordan said on Tuesday it rejected Netanyahu's decisions to build Jewish settlements around Arab East Jerusalem and limit the scale of Israel's withdrawal from the West Bank.
